166803.synopsis:
Jian Tao was originally a young master born into a wealthy family. He was pampered by his family and lived a sheltered life in an ivory tower. Due to an unexpected accident, he became bound to System 250, which is a “Cannon Fodder Villain” system for beginners. In order to return home as quickly as possible, Jian Tao and System 250 reached a perfect agreement.
System 250 asked, “What is our slogan?” Jian Tao replied, “Be annoying and do bad things!”
To ensure that the role of the cannon fodder villain would be deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, System 250 came equipped with a built-in beauty shielding function. However, when it was applied to Jian Tao, the function malfunctioned.
The system notification stated, “The beauty level has broken the peak value, and it is impossible to shield.”
One person and one system fell into a long silence. As the system, 250 was the first to cheer up and asked, “What is our slogan?” Jian Tao replied, “Be annoying and do bad things!” System 250 declared, “Then we shall be even more annoying and do even more bad things!” Jian Tao was also injected with adrenaline and said, “I want to be the worst villain of all!”
However, when the plot arrived and he faced the powerful protagonist, Jian Tao’s legs went weak as he gave the other person a slap. He did not expect that the protagonist would not only stay calm but would also smile while forcing him into a corner and asking, “Does your hand hurt?”
Jian Tao was so cowardly that the rims of his eyes turned red as he cried, “System, I am afraid.” System 250 replied, “I am also afraid, boo hoo hoo.”
World One: The Disfigured Sickly Beauty Dropped His Mask
He is a short-lived cannon fodder character who was disfigured after failing to commit an evil act. He is the object of everyone’s loathing and was framed into marrying the protagonist’s older brother, who is a man of unpredictable moods. According to the original plot, his end is to die tragically in a bathtub.
However, when his mask fell off, a delicate and beautiful face was revealed. His timid and fearful appearance made everyone’s hearts feel numb with attraction. Those people who had originally designed the traps for him all began to feel regret.
World Two: The Player in the Infinite World was Cursed
He was cursed by the Infinite World. During the day, he is a “Shamate” (punk) player whom everyone despises. At night, he transforms into a Night Demon wearing a terrifying mask. His body moves out of his own control, and he specifically does things to harass other players.
His original destiny was to be brutally beaten, but that changed once his mask fell off. Not only did the players allow him to act recklessly, but they also kidnapped him and took him into their rooms. Jian Tao clutched his secret identity tightly in fear and warned the players that the Night Demon was dangerous, but he did not expect that this would make them even more excited.
One-Sentence Summary: The villain was bullied again.
Theme: Good deeds are rewarded with good, and evil deeds are met with evil.
